taste:
The Vegan Wellington offers a savoury, hearty roast dinner built around the contrast between crisp pastry and a tender filling. Its flaky vegan wrapper gives each mouthful a different texture from the vegetables and pulses inside. The filling is described as wholesome and robust in flavour, rather than simply a pastry shell with vegetables on the side.

Golden roasted potatoes and fresh seasonal vegetables give the plate its traditional Sunday roast character. A deep, flavourful vegan gravy adds to the savoury profile and accompanies all the main elements. Served hot and fresh, this is a comforting plant-based option for diners who want the familiar format of a roast without animal products.
